_comment: Domain knowledge that no general-purpose embedding model carries.
An advisor asking for 'address proof' wants the electricity bill, but nothing in the bill's
text is distributionally close to that phrase: it talks about meter readings and direct
debits. Five embedding models were measured on this corpus (all-MiniLM-L6-v2,
multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1, msmarco-MiniLM-L6-cos-v5, e5-small-v2, bge-small-en-v1.5) and all
five ranked the bill 13th or worse for that query while ranking every other probe first.
The association is procedural knowledge about which documents evidence what, so it is supplied
explicitly here rather than hoped for from the model.
Expansions widen the semantic arm only. The lexical arm exists to match exact tokens, and
OR-ing extra terms into it would cost precision for recall the semantic arm already provides.

rules.concept: acting for someone who has lost capacity
triggers: acting on behalf of a client
expansions: lasting power of attorney attorney appointed
